WITH history AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    b.closePrice AS `v1`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ?
),
history_ranked AS (
  SELECT history.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate DESC) AS observation_rank
  FROM history
),
observed_tail AS (
  SELECT * FROM history_ranked WHERE observation_rank<=39
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT observed_tail.*, `v1` - LAG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate) AS `price_delta`
  FROM observed_tail
),
features AS (
  SELECT deltas.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(price_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 5 THEN 100 - 100 / (1 + (AVG(GREATEST(price_delta,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) / NULLIF(AVG(GREATEST(-price_delta,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),0)) ELSE NULL END AS `f1`,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=20 THEN AVG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ELSE NULL END AS `f2`
  FROM deltas
),
predicates AS (
  SELECT features.*,
    (`f1` > ?) AS `pc1`,
    (`f2` > ?) AS `pc2`
  FROM features
),
counted AS (
  SELECT predicates.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=4 THEN (SUM(CASE WHEN `pc1` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=3 AND NOT COALESCE(LAG(`pc1`,3) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate),FALSE)) ELSE NULL END AS `c1`,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=20 THEN (SUM(CASE WHEN `pc2` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)>=3) ELSE NULL END AS `c2`
  FROM predicates
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM counted WHERE bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode,tgtcode
FROM current_rows
WHERE (`c1` OR `c2`)
ORDER BY mktcode,tgtcode;

WITH history AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    b.closePrice AS `v1`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ?
),
history_ranked AS (
  SELECT history.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate DESC) AS observation_rank
  FROM history
),
observed_tail AS (
  SELECT * FROM history_ranked WHERE observation_rank<=39
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT observed_tail.*, `v1` - LAG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate) AS `price_delta`
  FROM observed_tail
),
features AS (
  SELECT deltas.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(price_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 5 THEN 100 - 100 / (1 + (AVG(GREATEST(price_delta,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) / NULLIF(AVG(GREATEST(-price_delta,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),0)) ELSE NULL END AS `f1`,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=20 THEN AVG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ELSE NULL END AS `f2`
  FROM deltas
),
predicates AS (
  SELECT features.*,
    (`f1` > ?) AS `pc1`,
    (`f2` > ?) AS `pc2`
  FROM features
),
counted AS (
  SELECT predicates.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=4 THEN (SUM(CASE WHEN `pc1` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=3 AND NOT COALESCE(LAG(`pc1`,3) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate),FALSE)) ELSE NULL END AS `c1`,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=20 THEN (SUM(CASE WHEN `pc2` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)>=3) ELSE NULL END AS `c2`
  FROM predicates
),
coverage_counted AS (
  SELECT counted.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(`pc1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=4 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS `availability_c1`,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(`pc2`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=20 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS `availability_c2`
  FROM counted
),
coverage_current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM coverage_counted WHERE bizdate=?
)

  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,

history_ranked AS (
  SELECT history.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate DESC) AS observation_rank
  FROM history
),
observed_tail AS (
  SELECT * FROM history_ranked WHERE observation_rank<=39
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT observed_tail.*, `v1` - LAG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate) AS `price_delta`
  FROM observed_tail
),
features AS (
  SELECT deltas.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(price_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 5 THEN 100 - 100 / (1 + (AVG(GREATEST(price_delta,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) / NULLIF(AVG(GREATEST(-price_delta,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),0)) ELSE NULL END AS `f1`,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=20 THEN AVG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ELSE NULL END AS `f2`
  FROM deltas
),
predicates AS (
  SELECT features.*,
    (`f1` > ?) AS `pc1`,
    (`f2` > ?) AS `pc2`
  FROM features
),
counted AS (
  SELECT predicates.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=4 THEN (SUM(CASE WHEN `pc1` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=3 AND NOT COALESCE(LAG(`pc1`,3) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate),FALSE)) ELSE NULL END AS `c1`,

coverage_totals AS (
